module_summary: IP receive parser for 64-bit Ethernet frames: a 5-state FSM captures IP header words into field registers, verifies version/IHL and checksum, then realigns payload by 32 bits into a skid-buffered output stream.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, read header, read payload, payload last, wait last (drop).

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid; starts frame reception in idle.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Ethernet header ready, asserted in idle when output header free.

anchors.name: s_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Ethernet header field latched with MAC/type registers.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Ethernet payload data: parsed into IP header fields and shifted payload.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload beat valid; advances header pointer and checksum partial sums.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from FSM and output backpressure.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame end; sets saved tlast and extra shift cycle.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header valid, raised after good checksum.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream accepts IP header, clearing header valid.

anchors.name: m_ip_dest_ip
anchors.why: Decoded destination IP output field.

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip
anchors.why: Decoded source IP output field.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: IP payload output data from skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: IP payload output valid.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready; drives skid buffer and early ready.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Payload end-of-frame output.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Frame ended inside IP header.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Frame ended before IP length satisfied.

anchors.name: error_invalid_header
anchors.why: Version/IHL check failed.

anchors.name: error_invalid_checksum
anchors.why: IP header checksum mismatch.

anchors.name: store_eth_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable for Ethernet MAC/type registers.

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_0
anchors.why: Loads first header word fields (version, IHL, length, flags).

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_1
anchors.why: Loads TTL, protocol, checksum, source IP.

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_2
anchors.why: Loads destination IP.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Saves last payload word for READ_PAYLOAD_LAST.

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte pointer selecting which header word to store.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes from IP length; trims tkeep and detects early end.

anchors.name: hdr_sum_low_reg
anchors.why: Partial 16-bit sum of low half of beat for checksum.

anchors.name: hdr_sum_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated IP header checksum sum.

anchors.name: hdr_sum_temp
anchors.why: Folded final checksum compared against all-ones.

anchors.name: check_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Pending checksum check next cycle; gates header valid or drop.

anchors.name: m_ip_length_reg
anchors.why: Captured IP length; initializes payload word count.

anchors.name: m_ip_version_reg
anchors.why: Captured IP version checked for validity.

anchors.name: save_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Previous payload beat saved for 32-bit realignment.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Realigned payload combining saved and current beats.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of realigned payload beat.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Realigned last flag; terminates header/payload states.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_s_tready
anchors.why: Shifter input ready, low during extra flush cycle.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra output cycle needed for leftover upper bytes.

anchors.name: flush_save
anchors.why: Clears saved beat state at frame end.

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Load enable for saved payload beat.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload word while consuming trailing frame bytes.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal payload valid into skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating payload transfer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early ready when output ready or both buffers empty.

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal payload into output register.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads internal payload into temp register.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp register to output register.

groups.name: Receive FSM
groups.description: Sequences header capture, payload transfer and frame drop with header handshakes.

groups.name: IP header field registers
groups.description: Parsed Ethernet and IP header fields driven in parallel to outputs.

groups.name: Header checksum
groups.description: Accumulates 16-bit header sums and checks the folded checksum.

groups.name: Payload realignment
groups.description: Shifts payload by 32 bits using saved beat and extra flush cycle.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving the IP payload stream.
